summary: Conditional release path: if the object pointer at this+0 is non-null, calls RefcountDecrementWithLock (00598C88) to obtain a vtable-like pointer, and if that result is also non-null, invokes virtual method slot 0 on it with argument 1 (thiscall). operations.description: Guard on the object pointer at this+0 being non-null; skip everything when it is null.
Call RefcountDecrementWithLock (00598C88) and store its result as the vtable-like pointer v1.
Guard on v1 being non-null before dispatching.
Invoke virtual slot 0 through v1 as a thiscall with argument 1; the concrete method target is only known at runtime.
